question: Who should I start Trey Mcbride or Bowers for week 7
answer:
Start Brock Bowers over Trey McBride. Bowers = Brock Bowers, LV TE. Most supported by the data: Recent trend (strong): Bowers had 27.6 PPR points per game in weeks 1-3 versus 18.2 from week 4 on, while McBride had 19.7 in weeks 1-3 versus 14.7 from week 4 on, showing Bowers's larger recent decline and higher early-season production; Next matchup (strong): Trey McBride faces a much friendlier DEN defense (rank 15, 13.2 PPR allowed) while Brock Bowers faces a tough LA matchup (rank 31, 8.3 PPR allowed); Weekly opportunity (moderate): Brock Bowers averages 20.6 PPR points per game versus Trey McBride's 17.2, with both players receiving identical 10.8 targets per game. Rule: start the player with more PPR points per game: Trey McBride 17.2 vs Brock Bowers 20.6. Decided by points per game. evidence.sql: SELECT ps.player_display_name AS player, 3 AS split_week, SUM(CASE WHEN ps.week <= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS early_games, SUM(CASE WHEN ps.week > 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late_games, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN ps.week <= 3 THEN ps.fantasy_points_ppr END), 1) AS early_ppr_per_game, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN ps.week > 3 THEN ps.fantasy_points_ppr END), 1) AS late_ppr_per_game, ROUND(100 * AVG(CASE WHEN ps.week <= 3 THEN ps.target_share END), 1) AS early_target_share_pct, ROUND(100 * AVG(CASE WHEN ps.week > 3 THEN ps.target_share END), 1) AS late_target_share_pct FROM NFLVERSE.player_stats ps WHERE ps.season = 2026 AND ps.player_id IN ('00-0037744', '00-0039338') GROUP BY ps.player_display_name ORDER BY ps.player_display_name

factors.summary: Trey McBride faces a much friendlier DEN defense (rank 15, 13.2 PPR allowed) while Brock Bowers faces a tough LA matchup (rank 31, 8.3 PPR allowed).
